readerCopy.body: One clear request can make care more available than waiting to see if somebody notices the need on their own. When the Moon sextiles Chiron, care and sensitivity cooperate, making a meal, ride, quieter plan, practical favor, or hour of support easier to ask for and provide. The useful change is not becoming perfectly comfortable with needing people. It is giving care a concrete job before disappointment has to become the messenger.
